verdict.rationale: Langfuse docs explicitly describe out-of-the-box token/cost tracking, custom dashboards to monitor cost across models, tags, or users, and a Metrics API to query aggregate cost/usage/latency by time period, plus alerting on spend thresholds. Community feedback corroborates real-world use for tracking cost/latency at scale (e.g. $60k+/month LLM spend monitoring). Missing for 10: independent third-party verification of dashboard usability/accuracy beyond vendor docs and anecdotal community praise.
